title: PF1e combat profile
description: The ```combat-profile block in a stat block or character sheet, read by scripts/combat.py. How to translate a PF1e stat block into it: library/pf1e/combat-profile-guide.md. Check a file with: python3 scripts/combat.py -c <campaign> profile check <file>.

kind.description: creature: NPCs and monsters (the DM rolls their attacks). pc: player characters (the player rolls; only defensive numbers needed).

hp.description: Hit points as listed (a PC's current HP lives on the sheet's HP line).

save_notes.description: Conditional save bonuses, e.g. '+2 vs. fear'. Not automated: the DM applies them.

ac_notes.description: Conditional AC bonuses, e.g. '+4 dodge vs. giants'.

size.description: Squares per side: 1 = Medium or smaller, 2 = Large, 3 = Huge, 4 = Gargantuan.

reach.description: Natural reach in feet (the second number of Space/Reach).

dr.description: Damage reduction amount (hardness for objects). combat.py subtracts it from every hit.

dr_bypass.description: What overcomes the DR, e.g. 'magic', 'silver', 'cold iron/good', '-' for DR x/-. Not automated yet.

resist.description: Energy resistance, e.g. {"fire": 10}. Not automated yet.

str.description: Strength score. Conditions that change Str (fatigued, exhausted, paralyzed) recompute melee attacks and damage from it.

dex.description: Dexterity score (extra AoOs with Combat Reflexes). Conditions that change Dex (grappled, entangled, fatigued, helpless, …) recompute AC, touch, flat-footed AC, Reflex and ranged attacks from it.

max_dex.description: The armor's (or shield's) max Dex bonus, if it caps the Dex bonus in AC. Needed so a Dex penalty doesn't lower AC when the cap already limits it.

feats.description: At least those the script uses: Combat Reflexes, Precise Shot, Improved Initiative. Listing all is fine.

aoo.description: AoOs per round, only if it differs from the rules (1, +Dex with Combat Reflexes).

attacks.description: One entry per distinct attack. Required for kind creature (may be empty for a creature that doesn't attack).

bonus.description: Total attack bonus; a list for iterative attacks (+6/+1 -> [6, 1]).

damage.description: Dice expression, e.g. '1d8+4'. Riders go in 'rider'.

touch.description: A touch attack (e.g. a spell or incorporeal touch).

crit.description: Lowest number of the threat range: /19-20 -> 19. Default 20.

range.description: Range increment in feet. Required for ranged and thrown attacks (from the weapon table).

ability.description: Ability behind the attack roll, if not the default (Str for melee, Dex for ranged): 'dex' with Weapon Finesse, 'none' for e.g. a touch spell cast by ability-independent means.

str_damage.description: Str multiplier on damage, if not the default (1 for melee and thrown, 0 for other ranged): 1.5 two-handed or a sole natural attack, 0.5 off-hand or secondary natural attacks, 1 composite bow.

reach.description: Reach of this attack, if it differs from the creature's (e.g. a longspear).

rider.description: What happens on a hit besides damage, e.g. 'plus trip', 'plus poison (DC 13 Fort, 1d2 Str)', 'plus 1d6 fire'. Not automated: the DM applies it.

full_attack.description: Attack names used in a full attack, repeated as often as they're made ('2 claws' -> ['claw', 'claw']). Omit if the only full attack is one weapon's iterative bonuses.

spellcasting.description: One entry per spellcasting class or source.

concentration.description: The concentration bonus from the stat block (CL + casting ability modifier, plus feats).

dc_base.description: 10 + casting ability modifier; a spell's DC is dc_base + spell level.

slots.description: Spells per day by level (spontaneous), or the number of prepared spells per level (prepared). Level 0 is at will: use 99.

spells.description: Prepared: the prepared list, repeated per copy ('sleep' twice if prepared twice). Spontaneous: spells known.

concentration.description: Concentration bonus from the Spell-Like Abilities line (defaults to the CL).

special.description: Other combat-relevant abilities in one line each, e.g. 'ferocity', 'pounce', 'grab (Medium)'. Not automated.

source.description: Where the numbers come from, e.g. 'Bestiary pg. 156'.
